procedure_text:
A saturated solution of about 50 mg of tembotrione in the 1st solvent stated in Table 5 was prepared at room temperature in a test vessel. Next hexane or water as the 2nd solvent was added dropwise until the onset of crystallization. The test vessel was sealed and left at room temperature for 16 hrs. In this manner, tembotrione was obtained in the form of crystals, which were isolated and analyzed by X-ray powder diffractometry (XRD). In all cases mixtures of modifications A and B were obtained.
| 21 | acetone | water | needles | A + B |
procedure_summary: A saturated solution of tembotrione in the first solvent named in this row was prepared at room temperature, the second solvent was added dropwise until crystallisation began, and after standing sealed at room temperature the crystals were isolated and identified by X-ray powder diffractometry as a mixture of two modifications.
notes: Comparative example 21 as printed in TABLE 5, row 1 of 3, at line 513. NUMBERING DEFECT, RECORDED AND NOT RECONCILED: the heading at line 507 reads 'Comparative Examples 21 to 22' but TABLE 5 prints three body rows, 21, 22 and 23. Both printed copies of the table carry row 23 and the vision pass confirmed it against the page image, so this is the published document's own defect and not a transcription artifact. A0 set estimated_steps to 3, counting the rows. All three rows are recorded. Row 23 lies outside the range the heading promises and is left that way: nothing here decides whether the heading or the table is wrong. The enriched file prints TABLE 5 twice, at 510-515 and again at 517-522. The second copy is the EN rendering of the same paragraph whose continuation lines lost their '> EN:' prefix, not a second table on the page, so only the first copy is cited. Produced by the A2 pass, run by Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]), reading lines 507-522 of the enriched text together with the p09 vision record. step_label follows the Step N convention both completed runs in this repo use, so the printed comparative example number is not in the reaction_id; it is recorded here as the first sentence and in the provenance quote, which is the row verbatim, so the mapping from record to printed row is not lost. Every row of this table shares one procedure, [0082] at line 509; the row supplies the 1st solvent, the 2nd solvent, the habit and the modification. procedure_text is that paragraph verbatim followed by this row verbatim. REGIME: this is an antisolvent crystallisation, not a cooling crystallisation. A saturated solution in the 1st solvent is made at room temperature, the 2nd solvent is added dropwise until crystallisation starts, and the sealed vessel then stands at room temperature for 16 hrs. There is no heating and no cooling, so heating_method and cooling_method are null and the temperature is room_temperature for both stages. The 2nd solvent is an antisolvent: it is added dropwise until crystallisation starts. The schema's role enum has no antisolvent value, so its role is solvent, which is also A1's role for it, and the antisolvent function is carried in addition_profile. process_control is populated here and nowhere else in these six sections: the addition endpoint is an in-process observation, the onset of crystallisation, not an analysis of the isolated product. The X-ray powder diffractometry that follows is still analytics. workup_type is tagged precipitation rather than crystallisation because the solid is brought out by adding an antisolvent and not by cooling; the transformation tag stays crystallisation, which is the row's own word. MIXTURE, NOT A PURE FORM: the row's Modification cell reads 'A + B', so the product is a mixture of tembotrione crystalline form A and tembotrione crystalline form B. Both are carried in compounds with is_product true. product_name is null because it is one string and cannot name two forms without coining a phrase the patent does not print. No majority component is chosen, because the row states no ratio, and naming a single form would misreport the very result this comparative set exists to show. [0082] states the mixture outcome in prose as well: 'In all cases mixtures of modifications A and B were obtained'. Prose and table agree for all three rows. The row prints the crystal habit as 'needles'; no field holds a habit, so it is recorded here. NO BOND IS MADE OR BROKEN: tembotrione is crystallised and recovered as the same molecule in a different lattice, so reaction_class is recrystallisation and mechanism_type is not_determinable. There is no reagent, catalyst, base, acid, oxidant or reductant, only a solute, a solvent and an antisolvent. The sealed test vessel is recorded in reactor_type. It is not recorded as an atmosphere, because no atmosphere is named, and not as elevated pressure, because none is stated. The text does not mention stirring. 'left there' implies the vessel stood undisturbed, but that is an inference, so stirring.type is null rather than none. purification is null and the purification tag is none: the crystallisation is itself the transformation and is carried in reaction_class, and the text states no further purification of the crystals. Recording it twice would create two sources of truth. X-ray powder diffractometry identifies the isolated solid, so it is analytics and not in-process monitoring; process_control is left empty. The form is an identification, not a purity measurement, so product_purity_method stays null. The charge is stated as 'about 50 mg', recorded as 0.05 g with the approximation noted here; neither solvent volume is stated, the first because the solution is defined by saturation and the second because the addition is to an endpoint. No yield, no isolated product mass and no assay purity is stated anywhere in this section, and nothing is computed from the charge. safety_notes is empty because the section states none; the hazards of the solvent are not the document's words and hazard assessment belongs to A5. selectivity is null throughout. The modification obtained is the identity of the product, recorded in compounds and product_name; it is not a stated regio-, stereo- or chemoselectivity and the document reports no ee, de or dr. non_synthetic is true. The field has no prose definition in the prompt set or in reactions.schema.json, so the only thing carrying meaning in it is consistency across the run, and the run's discriminator is whether a bond changes. No bond is formed or broken in this step: the same substance stands on both sides, and only the lattice differs. Every recrystallisation step in both runs on disk that has any, CN111440099B and EP2045236A1, is true, while every bond-forming step in those runs is false, and the inventive Example sections, the formulation records and the claims records of this run all set it true. CORRECTED FROM FALSE after the adversarial audit found these six files were the only dissent in the run; the value is the only thing that changed. is_one_pot is false: the two solvents are one crystallisation with one charge and one isolation, not two sequential transformations. Row 21 is the only row whose 2nd solvent is water, which is what [0082]'s 'hexane or water' refers to.
